tools.name: ring_list
tools.description: Webring members in ring order. Optional kind/category filters and limit/offset pagination.

tools.name: ring_next
tools.description: The next member around the ring from a slug, URL, or hostname (wraps). Omit from to enter at the start.

tools.name: ring_prev
tools.description: The previous member around the ring (wraps).

tools.name: ring_member
tools.description: One member by slug, with leaderboard rank.

tools.name: ring_leaderboard
tools.description: Members ranked by standing bid totals (cumulative, but decaying when quiet; any new bid revives the full total); #1 holds the homepage spot. to_take_first_usd is the single bid that takes #1. Optional limit/offset.

tools.name: ring_categories
tools.description: Categories in use, with member counts.

tools.name: ring_join_info
tools.description: How to join the ring: fee, validation requirements, and the MPP (HTTP 402) payment flow.

tools.name: ring_bid_info
tools.description: How to bid a member up the leaderboard: minimum, auction rules, and the MPP payment flow.
